answer: Each identity posts a 40-credit bond to the juniper registry and declares its funding source. A plume panel traces each declaration two hops and groups identities sharing a source. The k-th identity in a group pays 40 + 10(k-1) credits, held in a tundra vault until epoch close, so cost rises per clone. One group of 1,000 fakes locks 5,035,000 credits, with no merging across groups. A rented-funding-source ring fails: splitting sources costs 200 onboarding per new source, and auditors burn bonds sharing a hidden wallet. An honest agent pays one 40-credit bond, refunded after a clean epoch.
